There are two notable films titled *A Christmas Proposal* : a 2008 romantic comedy and a 2021 holiday romance.

### 2008 Film

The [A Christmas Proposal (2008)](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1284976/) movie is about two former childhood sweethearts who are lawyers. They argue over a plan to turn a mountain town into a ski resort. It stars Nicole Eggert and David O'Donnell. You can stream it for free on platforms like [[Tubi](https://tubitv.com/movies/689144/a-christmas-proposal?start=true&tracking=google-feed&utm_source=google-feed) ](https://tubitv.com/movies/689144/a-christmas-proposal?start=true&tracking=google-feed&utm_source=google-feed) and [[Pluto TV](https://pluto.tv/on-demand/movies/a-christmas-proposal-2008-1-1?utm_medium=textsearch&utm_source=google) ](https://pluto.tv/on-demand/movies/a-christmas-proposal-2008-1-1?utm_medium=textsearch&utm_source=google).

### 2021 Film

The [A Christmas Proposal (2021)](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt14807078/) movie follows a chef who agrees to pose as a Seattle attorney's girlfriend. They visit his family to help him win a promotion at the family firm. It stars Jessica Camacho and Adam Rodriguez.
